title: Spotify's Phony War On Bots
summary: Musician Benn Jordan explains how all of his music was removed from Spotify and walks through the history of digital music distribution and fake streams. He argues that Spotify's anti-bot measures are mostly a phony war.
why: HN cites it as a firsthand example of artists losing catalogs with no recourse and of the middlemen in music streaming.
topic: spotify fake streams and music distribution

quote.text: a video of someone who had all their Spotify music removed with no recourse
